title: What If Earth Spun Backwards?
altTitles: If Earth Spun Backwards, the Sahara Would Turn Green
description: Reverse Earth's spin and the Sun rises in the west — but that's the least strange part. In 2018, Max Planck Institute scientists ran a full Earth-system model of a backwards-spinning planet: the Sahara greens, the Americas dry out and the Atlantic's overturning current collapses. Source: Mikolajewicz et al. 2018, Earth System Dynamics. #whatif #earth #climate
